newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO PESO ZIGZAGS ON LONG BOND TO END FIRM.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO PESO ZIGZAGS ON LONG BOND TO END FIRM.

text.p: Benchmark Mexican peso contracts moderated earlier gains, but ended firmer for the third day in a row on Wednesday after a volatile session on the back of the U.S. long bond, dealers said.
"Mild U.S. data pushed down long bond yields and firmed the peso early on. But fears of rate increases in Germany made the market a little nervous later on," one said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate ended 0.8 and 0.55 centavos firmer, respectively, at 7.7760/7.7790 and 7.7740/7.7770 per dollar.
